fields.label: Enable Third-Party Plugins
fields.description: Off: no plugin can be installed or run. Only System Managers install, enable or remove plugins.

fields.label: Allow Processing Plugins
fields.description: Plugins that add QGIS Processing algorithms; they run only in the processing worker.

fields.label: Allow QGIS Server Plugins
fields.description: Plugins loaded by QGIS Server itself (restart QGIS Server after a change).

fields.label: Manage QGIS Server Plugins
fields.description: QGIS Server and its plugin folder are shared by every bench and site on this host. Turn this on for exactly one site; only that site installs or removes server plugins, and only it reads the folder.

fields.label: Enforce Compatibility
fields.description: Only install plugins whose analysis matches their kind (e.g. Processing-compatible for processing plugins) and whose QGIS version range includes this QGIS.

fields.label: Allowed Download Sources
fields.description: One URL prefix per line. A plugin package can be downloaded from these; any other package must be uploaded by a System Manager.

fields.label: QGIS Plugin Repository
fields.description: Searched by Browse Repository; the installed QGIS version is added to the request.

fields.label: QGIS Server Plugin Directory
fields.description: QGIS_PLUGINPATH of the qgis-server service. The bench user must be able to write it, QGIS Server's user to read it.

fields.label: Processing Plugin Directory
fields.description: Inside the site's private files; only the processing worker loads from it.

fields.label: QGIS Server Restart Required
fields.description: A server plugin was installed, enabled, disabled or removed: run sudo systemctl restart qgis-server, then clear this with Mark Restarted.

name: GIS Plugin Settings
description: Who may install QGIS plugins, from where, and where they go.
